About the Project

Reading's Mathematics for our Future Climate CDT supports doctoral work on mathematical questions connected to climate. Applicants join a research training programme where mathematical methods are developed and applied to climate processes and future environmental change.

Research Areas

  • Mathematics
  • Climate science
  • Environmental modelling

ComponentDetails

Stipend / salaryHome: GBP 30,000/year; other stipend GBP 23,805/year (2026/27)

About University of Reading

Reading hosts research in mathematics, climate and other disciplines. Its Mathematics for our Future Climate doctoral training programme combines mathematical research with questions about climate processes and future environmental change.
